logic.description: Implemented 2026-10-29 (scout). A left-clicked tile → the map around it is revealed to me and a popup names what lies there (units, traps, obstacles, tokens). An enemy in contact instead → if my World beats theirs, they show me their hand (popup with the card names; the peek travels as an evt_peek envelope to me only). ∀ library leg: not implemented.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
Either a tile was chosen or an enemy stands in reach.

effects.description: A chosen tile → the disc around it becomes known to me (reveal radius).
An enemy in reach → I see their hand when my World is strictly above theirs.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_time (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.

call: nobody in reach and no tile
